ctx.x: Well, for example, if I can give you a little turn of my life, the name Jay McShann has, Hootie, you know, now they used to say that he'd drink some whisky and then he would hoot like an owl, you know. He'd stay up so late that he was up with the Hoot owls.
Oh, it has nothing to do with hootch then?
